name: Moving day, told through folded paper and rich answer cards
object: GPT-6 in ChatGPT with Intelligent UI: answers that render as rich, glanceable cards (a bike-build diagram, a neighborhood map, a color palette) instead of walls of plain text
audience: everyday ChatGPT users doing real-world tasks, like moving into a new home, who get buried in dense instructions
message: This video tells everyday users that some answers need more than words: GPT-6's Intelligent UI turns a paragraph of instructions into something you can actually glance at and use.

moments.what: a couple moves into a new house, unpacking boxes, intercut with hands folding paper into origami shapes and unfolding dense printed instructions, a color-palette card, a bike-assembly sheet
close-ups of people squinting at walls of plain text, an origami recipe written out as paragraphs, a huge paper neighborhood map awkwardly unfolded on a city overpass

the same tasks now solved on a phone screen as rich cards: a labeled bike-build diagram, a neighborhood guide map, a tidy color-swatch grid, glanced at in seconds while the couple relaxes amid the boxes
title cards read "Sometimes words aren't enough" then "GPT-6 with Intelligent UI," closing on a grid of ChatGPT app icons
moments.copy: Sometimes words aren't enough. GPT-6, with Intelligent UI.

cta: "Sometimes words aren't enough: GPT-6 with Intelligent UI", staged as closing title cards over the ChatGPT app icon grid
why: Building the whole film around a literal folding-paper metaphor, dense instructions versus a clean card, lets the viewer feel the relief of Intelligent UI before a single feature is named.
